extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors, media professionals, members of the press and the interested public in India
extracted.subtask_description: Homepage of the Editors Guild of India describing the organization's purpose, recent statements, reports, events, constitution, awards, and the 2025-26 executive committee. Serves as an informational/organizational page rather than a detailed production or evaluation rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Twin objectives: protect press freedom and raise editorial standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editors Guild was founded in 1978 with the twin objectives of protecting press freedom and for raising the standards of editorial leadership of newspapers and magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Guild pursues these objectives through issuing official statements, conducting fact-finding mission reports, hosting the RM Memorial Lecture, maintaining a constitution and rules, and promoting awards & fellowships. (Page lists these activities but provides no detailed criteria or standards for assessing editorial quality.)
